- Double the number: \(2x\)
- Decrease by \(13.7\): \(2x - 13.7\)
- The result is greater than \(125.28\):

\[
2x - 13.7 > 125.28
\]

Add \(13.7\) to both sides:

\[
2x > 138.98
\]

Divide by \(2\):

\[
x > 69.49
\]

The smallest integer greater than \(69.49\) is \(70\).

The answer is 70.
